revision.refused: No edits committed. The report requests no changes and identifies no missing historical information or unclear transition. The existing instructions already map smaller-x upper-arc traversals to D and larger-x lower-arc traversals to C, require selecting the first demonstrated letter while writing the complete initial route, and prohibit replacing supported demonstration evidence with a location-based fallback. The reported initial choices contradict these rules rather than establish a memory or instruction gap. Additional fields, episode-specific exceptions, and changes to annotation or update timing are unwarranted. The general initialization clarification and fallback restriction committed in round 3 remain intact, as does the one-completed-command, one-leading-letter removal rule supported by later decisions.
